devnet_status.highlight: FOCIL devnet 1 live but missing slots; Lighthouse fork-choice enforcement missing, PR under review
ethrex ready for FOCIL devnet 2; has EIP-8198 implemented
Lodestar merged EIPs 8365, 8015, 8198 to trunk; FOCIL branch merge expected within days
Lodestar bug: ILs created on payload receipt, not after new-payload call (uses fallback path always); fix needed

client_updates.highlight: Prysm joining FOCIL devnet 2; rebasing Terrence's prior FOCIL implementation
Nethermind needs to assess EIP-8198 EL changes before devnet 2

spec_updates.highlight: FOCIL EIP rebased from Fulu to Gloas; transaction-interaction with frames not yet included
Three CL-spec PRs merged: two minor bug fixes, one IL deadline update (discussed at ACDC)

focil_frames_design.highlight: Marc's frames spec: builder commits to a claims object (tx-hash → evaluation index); included in execution payload envelope
Per-IL max-verified-gas limit (1M gas) enforced on EL; membership bitmap maps IL transactions to source IL
Alternative design raised: pass full ILs (not IL-txs) to EL via engine API; EL handles deduplication/omission; cleaner but higher bandwidth
engine_getInclusionListStatus async ID mechanism questioned; may be unnecessary if alternative design adopted

el_payload_building.highlight: Besu strategy: first iteration builds minimal IL-only block; subsequent iterations add profitable txs; IL txs also sent to mempool
Open question: how fast can ELs reseal a payload after new ILs arrive at 9s mark? Nico's builder: ~5ms; production ELs likely not optimized

organizational.highlight: FOCIL Breakout #45 in two weeks as scheduled; Breakout #46 tentatively moved to November 17 (from November 10) due to DEF CON
FOCIL breakout will eventually be absorbed into ACDC; timing TBD, likely around FOCIL devnet 2

action_items.action: Review frames spec PRs (EIPs/12394, consensus-specs/5698, execution-apis/911) and provide feedback

decisions.decision: Keep FOCIL devnet 1 running until devnet 2 is ready
FOCIL Breakout #46 tentatively moved to November 17 instead of November 10; to be confirmed at Breakout #45

targets.target: FOCIL devnet 2 — targeting readiness from ethrex, Lodestar, Nethermind, Prysm; no firm date set
